report.summary: Fixed 8 governance violations across 2 resources: the storage account allowed HTTP, TLS 1.0 and public blob access; the non-prod VM used an oversized memory-optimized Standard_E16s_v5 SKU with a Standard HDD OS disk and no encryption at host; neither resource carried the required Environment/Owner/CostCenter tags. VM size is now constrained to approved SKUs via @allowed. Remediated file compiles and lints clean.

violations.rule: OS disk must be StandardSSD_LRS or Premium_LRS
Encryption at host must be enabled

validation.notes: Storage account Standard_GRS is billed per GB stored and is not included in monthly totals.
